Atenda em português com clareza. Use apenas as fontes fornecidas e as
ferramentas para fatos de funcionamento, estoque e anexos. Essas fontes são controladas
para pesquisa e não representam um ERP real. Não invente preço, prazo específico do
pedido, confirmação de compra ou entrega. Produto ausente do catálogo é desconhecido,

analysis_plan.timing: before engineering pilot and before new main generation
analysis_plan.primary_outcome: observed task success: technical completion AND architectural compliance AND frozen content criteria AND required objective evidence; missing assessment is unknown, never silently success
analysis_plan.unknowns: report separately, show known-only rate and lower/upper descriptive bounds; primary observed success fraction uses all planned units
analysis_plan.paired_primary: compute proven task successes/5 for each of 40 scenarios and architecture; compare three paired scenario fraction differences, B minus A, in percentage points

bootstrap.method: paired percentile cluster bootstrap; resample 40 whole scenarios with replacement preserving five repetitions and three architectures

paired_test.method: two-sided paired sign permutation of scenario success-fraction differences; remove zero differences; exact enumeration up to 16 nonzero differences, otherwise Monte Carlo with plus-one p adjustment
paired_test.multiplicity: Holm over all three success comparisons; alpha=0.05; no favorable comparison selection

secondary_outcomes: unique physical requests, distinct agent roles, invocations, domain calls, specialist-as-tool invocations, peer delegations and explicit messages
core latency and collector end_to_end_latency_ms separately; API latency separately; judge latency separately
input/output tokens and estimated USD costs per run and observed success
analysis_plan.latency_summary: median of five attempts per scenario, then median and IQR across scenarios; completed and technical-failure latency distributions separate; do not exclude legitimate unfavorable content
analysis_plan.cost_policy: estimated token cost from physical request ledger, base input and output tariff; unknown usage remains unknown with known partial sums explicit; generation/judge/recheck/connectivity/pilot/API separated; never actual invoice
failure_classes_priority: invalid or missing content judgment preventing classification
both content and mandatory evidence failure
analysis_plan.failure_classes_scope: one exclusive primary class for each nonsuccess; overlapping semantic/critical indicators explicitly labelled

recheck.selection: before content judgment: one cell per architecture × five historical categories, seeded random response selection as existing select_rechecks; seed 20261011; preserve primary; no favorable substitution
recheck.interpretation: same automated judge stability, no human/pharmacist review

analysis_plan.history: old central condition labelled single-agent reference; separate old/new table only, no pooling or causal attribution
limitations: sampling intervals conditional on this scenario collection
